decisions.reason: As a newly launched product with its own page, it likely has managerial backing and, in a large established German manufacturer with some slack, would usually be kept while early market feedback is still forming.
Its dedicated presentation suggests a deliberate launch commitment, and under uncertainty we would keep it for another year rather than redeploy resources prematurely.
Because it was only mentioned on the website, internal commitment appears weaker, but a large incumbent firm would still tolerate some short-run ambiguity before concluding it falls below aspiration.
A stand-alone page indicates stronger strategic attention, so despite normal early-launch uncertainty we would retain it and continue learning from the market.

This product line seems more tentative from its limited web presence, yet its fit with adjacent custom manufacturing capabilities gives enough reason to keep it while monitoring whether performance reaches aspiration.
Although only mentioned on the website, it likely shares resources and know-how with related earmold activities, which lowers the immediate pressure to drop it in the first post-launch year.
